description: Payroll and supplier payouts to many wallets in one batch, on Solana and on the nine EVM chains (those with loteSplit true in GET /v1/chains). EVM: up to 50 wallets, in a verified USD stablecoin (USDC, USDT, PYUSD, USDG, USD1) — the batch is ONE transaction through the Vurto IBBs split contract, and the payer pays the exact amounts PLUS a 0.1% Vurto fee on the total. Solana: up to 20 wallets, in any token the payer holds (no swap, no fee), packed into one or a few transactions. The paying wallet and every receiving wallet are screened first (OFAC SDN list and, on Solana, the issuer freeze of six stablecoins); a blocked payer refuses with payer_blocked (403), and one blocked recipient refuses the whole batch with receiver_blocked (403) and details.index of that row, before anything is created. Each recipient becomes a regular invoice (history, on-chain verification). EVM returns { invoices[], evm: { split, invoiceIds[], base, fee, batchRef, deadline, steps[] } }: sign steps IN ORDER with prepare_signing (the approve step first, then the pay transaction step), send them, and call payout_report_payment with the PAY transaction hash and evm.invoiceIds. Solana returns { invoices[], transactions[] }: sign each transactions[i].transaction (prepare_signing, then POST to /v1/svm/execute) and call payout_report_payment with that signature and its invoiceIds. checks (stablecoin token, both families) adds a PAID analysis of every destination, turning the batch into two steps. Scorechain runs on every EVM chain and Solana; Merkle Science (Didit) does not cover Gnosis, Unichain or Avalanche, so a check the chain lacks refuses with check_not_available_on_chain. With checks the response carries no transactions[]: Solana returns { invoices[], charge: { buildId, transaction, loteId, total, token, tokenDecimals, feeWallet, recipients }, reused[] } (prepare_signing with buildId and step {transaction}, POST to /v1/svm/execute); EVM returns the same charge plus charge.step, a transaction step ready for prepare_signing. Sign the charge transaction exactly as returned: it carries the mark that ties the payment to this charge (16 bytes after the transfer arguments on EVM, a memo on Solana). A transfer you build yourself is refused with analysis_payment_rejected, reason charge_not_tied, after the money has left; do not pay again, prove the wallet (destination_challenge with wallet = payer, receiver = details.feeWallet, chargeId = this charge and chargeTxHash = that hash, then destination_authorize) and report the same hash again. A Solana transaction expires in about a minute: POST /v1/payouts/charge/transaction with loteId and payer returns the same charge fresh, without another batch; if it also returns reportedTxHash, send that hash to payout_charge instead of signing, or you may pay twice. To pay the fee with another token, swap_build with tokenOut = charge.token, receiver = charge.feeWallet and loteId, with a minimum between charge.total and 10% above it. Then call payout_charge with that loteId, the charge hash/signature and the payer to analyse every destination, drop the blocked and get the approved send: Solana as transactions[] to sign, EVM as evm (the IBBs approve + pay steps of ONLY the approved, with the 0.1% fee recomputed on the approved base, with buildId, chainId and invoiceIds; if evm.deadline passed, call payout_charge again for a fresh one). Not re-charging a wallet already analysed (reused[]) needs the payer's signed session, which the API does not carry, so via MCP every destination is charged and reused[] is empty. Errors: batch_not_available_on_chain (an EVM chain without the IBBs contract), stablecoin_required (a checks batch in a non-stablecoin token), check_not_available_on_chain (a paid check the chain lacks, e.g. Merkle on Gnosis/Unichain/Avalanche), batch_duplicate_recipient (add the amounts up in one row), batch_self_payment, too_many_recipients, token_not_listed, screening_unavailable (503, try again).

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checks.description: Optional, both families, stablecoin token: the paid analysis tools to run on every destination (scorechain 0.10 USDC, merkle-science 0.40 USDC, per destination). Turns the batch into the two-step charge flow above.

payer.description: The wallet that signs and pays. EVM 0x address, or base58 on Solana.

amount.description: Human amount, e.g. "500" or "120.5". Exactly this reaches the wallet.

wallet.description: Receiving wallet (EVM 0x address, or base58 on Solana, case-sensitive). The payer cannot be one of them, and each wallet appears once (up to 50 on EVM, 20 on Solana).

token.description: Mint or symbol of a verified token, e.g. "USDC". Every recipient is paid in it. On EVM it must be a USD stablecoin; with checks on Solana it must be a USD stablecoin too.

name: payout_batch
